verdict.rationale: Host-side virtual display creation is a fair axis for a remote desktop product like RustDesk, but nothing in the evidence pack documents it. Multi-monitor capture and Wayland unattended access are adjacent features, not virtual or headless displays. The Windows driver-signing discussion never says what the driver does, so it cannot be credited.

support.subject: As a power user, the host can create a virtual display, so a streamed window keeps rendering when covered or the machine runs headless
